sections.Profile:
"Atlas" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in May 1959. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features four flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, two rollunders, two standup targets, and a roto-target.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Myth, Sports, Original Theme, Bodybuilding
